name: invariant
description: A single numbered normative invariant. Invariants are constraints that conforming implementations must always uphold. The applies_to FieldAssignment (fieldId 1a000021-0000-4000-a000-000000000021) retired here (RFC-042 Change E, srs#564): every invariant record now carries a contains parent from the concept it constrains instead. The Field definition itself is untouched pending removal as a follow-up under rfc-decision-5f8204bc (deprecate-then-remove) once no other Type references it.
